bio.text: Lydia Hernandez is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 24, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Hernandez is the daughter of migrant farmworkers, was born in the Rio Grande Valley of Texas, and is a graduate of Baylor University in political science and pre-law.
The profile says Hernandez has served on the Maryvale YMCA board of directors and the Maryvale Village Planning Commission, and as chair of the Human Services Commission.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 24 (candidate-submitted statements)
